description: Joint venture between Meta and BlackRock funds to build a ~1GW AI data-center campus in El Paso, Texas, at ~$14B total development cost. BlackRock funds hold 80% and Meta 20%; Meta contributed land/construction-in-progress (~$2.3B) and BlackRock made a ~$4.9B cash contribution. Announced July 28, 2026, first capacity due 2028.

Jacksonville, FL mobile power-generation firm operating one of the world's largest mobile gas/diesel turbine fleets (1.1+ GW), serving data centers and utilities with rapidly deployable on-site power. Quietly acquired by Elon Musk in a deal estimated at $1B+, disclosed via a May 2026 FTC early-termination filing and reported to be aimed at powering xAI's compute buildout.

Public e-commerce and cloud-computing company (AWS). In August 2026 Joshua Kushner's Thrive Capital disclosed a $215.5M public-market stake (~904,000 shares as of Q2 2026), part of Thrive's broader push into large public AI-adjacent holdings alongside Figma, Shopify and StubHub.

Strategic Bauxite USA, LLC (SBX) is building a vertically integrated U.S. refractory-grade bauxite supply chain after acquiring the First Bauxite mine in Guyana. In August 2026 the Department of War committed $85.5M equity (via its IBAS program, plus $64.5M private co-investment) to expand the mine and build calcination/brown-fused-alumina processing, reducing reliance on Chinese sources.

Neocloud/AI-infrastructure startup founded in 2026 by ex-Brookfield infrastructure executives Ricard Boada and Sofia Gumuzio, targeting mid-sized 'Little Tech' AI labs. Emerged from stealth in August 2026 with a $300M round co-led by a16z and Altimeter (NVIDIA and Michael Dell participating) at a $2.4B valuation, alongside a $10B six-year compute contract and $5B infrastructure financing.

Nuclear startup building small modular reactors (factory-built SMRs) for AI-factory power, having demonstrated its Ward 250 reactor powering an NVIDIA Blackwell system. Raised a $1B Series B led by Sequoia partner Shaun Maguire in August 2026 at a $6B valuation (tripling its prior mark), plus a $200M credit line from Erebor and other banks.

Blue Owl Capital-owned hyperscale data-center developer/operator (STACK Infrastructure). In July 2026 it was seeking an A$8.5B (~$5.9B) syndicated loan to fund its third Melbourne, Australia data-center campus, extending the broader AI-datacenter debt-financing boom; talks were reported at an early stage.

Fabless semiconductor company building e-Tube, an RF-over-plastic-waveguide interconnect for multi-terabit AI data-center and automotive links, pitched as lower-power, longer-reach than copper. Closed a $136M total Series B in August 2026, the latest tranche led by LB Investment with new backing from Arm alongside NVIDIA, Maverick Silicon, Molex and Bosch Ventures.

target: NextEra-Brookfield Paducah AI Data Center Campus
description: A planned $100B+ AI data-center campus at the U.S. Department of Energy's former Paducah, Kentucky uranium-enrichment site, announced July 2026. Brookfield (DOE-selected via RFO) will lease, own and operate the data-center campus; NextEra Energy will build/own up to ~2GW dedicated gas plus ~2.6GW battery storage. Expected to support ~1.8GW utility and 1.2GW+ compute capacity.

U.S. defense-tech maker of FPV/autonomous and counter-drone (interceptor) systems, including its Archer AI platform and Bandit c-UAS interceptor, aiming for 1M drones/year by 2028. Raised a $250M Series C in August 2026 co-led by Sequoia and the American Strategic Technology Fund at a $2.5B valuation, with Thiel Capital, Spark Capital, Valor Equity and others participating.

Not a single entity — the private-credit/infrastructure financing opportunity in Mexico that Apollo Global Management is targeting. In July 2026 Apollo said it aims to deploy up to $20B there via loans and structured financing for infrastructure projects, aligning with Mexico's push (under President Sheinbaum) to attract private capital. This is a stated deployment target, not a committed fund or single transaction.

Tel Aviv-based cybersecurity startup (founded 2025 by ex-Wiz/Microsoft veterans) building an agentic Security Operations Center platform that maintains a per-organization security context graph to automate detection, triage and response. Raised a $35M Series A in July 2026 led by Canaan Partners, with Insight Partners, Microsoft's M12 fund and Team8 participating, bringing total funding to $50M+.

Paris-based voice-AI startup spun out of French lab Kyutai, co-founded by ex-Google Brain/DeepMind researcher Neil Zeghidour, building low-latency text-to-speech, speech-to-text and voice-cloning models. Reopened its seed round to reach $100M total in July 2026, adding NVIDIA alongside earlier backers Eric Schmidt, FirstMark, Eurazeo, DST Global Partners and Xavier Niel.

San Francisco startup providing cloud infrastructure for faster CI/CD and code-validation workflows (used by 6,000+ companies including Supabase and Clerk), positioned to handle rising AI-generated-code test volume. Raised a $45M Series B in August 2026 led by Peak XV Partners, with Y Combinator and GV participating, at a $550M valuation.

A set of independent, NVIDIA-anchored financing platforms announced August 10, 2026 via MOUs with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR, aiming to mobilize $500B+ of third-party capital to fund data centers, power and AI infrastructure built on NVIDIA hardware — kept off NVIDIA's own balance sheet.
